scope.description: Heuristic scan of Git-listed active source and text configuration; generated reports, local state, ignored files, and named historical/scratch copies are excluded. This is not a product acceptance gate.
scope.testSourcePolicy: Test files are counted for presence but not searched for unfinished or placeholder implementation markers.
